compound qualifying the diagram as having four entrances

items.question: What specific shape and structural features must the requested diagram possess, O supreme goddess?
premises: The diagram is specified as four-cornered and square.
The diagram is specified as furnished with four gates.
The supreme goddess is directly addressed regarding this form.
items.inference: The requested diagram must be constructed as a square structure equipped with four gates.
uncertainties: The verb governing these attributes is supplied from the preceding verse (kuru).
items.plain_english: O supreme goddess, make it square and furnished with four gates.
